operating_notes.text: Acquired two ICV-classed mini bulk carriers (M.V. Gautam BSTAR II of 4408.50 DWT and M.V. Sanghi Sudarshan of 4402.30 DWT) aggregating 8,810.80 DWT.
Process of acquiring a vessel from the secondary market typically takes 50 to 100 days from identification.
Income Tax Department approved the company's option into the Tonnage Tax Scheme under Chapter XII-G for eligible qualifying inland vessels, effective FY2025-26 and AY 2026-27, expiring by FY2034-35.
Wholly owned subsidiary Shreeji Global IFSC Private Limited received final registration from IFSCA and commenced operations at GIFT City during FY26.
Incorporated 51% owned subsidiary Shreeji Tisha Maritime Private Limited on March 25, 2026.
As of March 31, 2026, ₹251.18 Cr allocated for Supramax dry bulk carrier acquisition remained unutilized.
Company secured Tonnage Tax Scheme approval under Chapter XII-G effective FY26.

timeline.summary: Executed vessel purchase agreements to acquire two mini bulk carrier vessels (8,810.80 DWT) from Gautam Freight Private Limited for ₹55.66 Cr.
Crisil Ratings issued Monitoring Agency report for Q4FY26 showing zero utilisation of ₹251.18 Cr Supramax vessel acquisition proceeds due to geopolitical and market factors.
Shreeji Shipping Global Limited received Income Tax Department approval for the Tonnage Tax Scheme effective from FY2025-26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹188.07 Cr, net profit ₹40.33 Cr.
Shreeji Shipping filed its Q4FY26 IPO proceeds statement showing zero deviation and ₹251.18 Cr unutilized for vessel acquisitions.
Shreeji Shipping reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹709.38 Cr and net profit of ₹152.70 Cr, driven by fleet expansion and operational scaling.
Ashokkumar Haridas Lal, promoter of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held by promoters or persons acting in concert during FY2025-26 on April 07, 2026.

upcoming_events.description: Scheduled delivery of two mini bulk carrier vessels at Bedi Port Anchorage
